from service import score, make_key
import hashlib

# Test cache key generation
def test_make_key():
    # All inputs unchanged, even None, should produce same key
    assert make_key("text", None, None) == make_key("text", None, None)
    
    # Changing any input should produce different key
    assert make_key("text1", None, None) != make_key("text", None, None)
    assert make_key("text", "profile1", None) != make_key("text", None, None)
    assert make_key("text", None, "criteria1") != make_key("text", None, None)
    
    # Explicit None values should be treated differently
    assert make_key(None, None, None) != make_key("text", None, None)
    
    # Different profiles with same text should have different keys
    assert make_key("text", "v1", None) != make_key("text", "v2", None)
    
    # Different criteria with same text/profile should have different keys
    assert make_key("text", None, "v1") != make_key("text", None, "v2")

# Test score function caching behavior
class MockCompute:
    def __init__(self):
        self.calls = 0
    
    def __call__(self):
        self.calls += 1
        return f"computed_{self.calls}"

def test_score_caching():
    store = {}
    compute = MockCompute()
    
    # First call should compute
    assert score(store, "text", None, None, compute) == "computed_1"
    
    # Same inputs should reuse cache
    assert score(store, "text", None, None, compute) == "computed_1"
    assert compute.calls == 1
    
    # Different text should recompute
    compute.calls = 0
    assert score(store, "text2", None, None, compute) == "computed_2"
    assert compute.calls == 1
    
    # Different profile should recompute
    compute.calls = 0
    assert score(store, "text", "profile1", None, compute) == "computed_3"
    assert compute.calls == 1
    
    # Different criteria should recompute
    compute.calls = 0
    assert score(store, "text", None, "criteria1", compute) == "computed_4"
    assert compute.calls == 1
    
    # None values should still be treated as unique inputs
    compute.calls = 0
    assert score(store, None, None, None, compute) == "computed_5"
    assert compute.calls == 1
